sources.entry: A guide to using your career to help solve the world’s most pressing problems

summary.title: Our new guide to doing good with your career
summary.one_liner: This 80,000 Hours key-ideas guide walks through how to choose a high-impact career by comparing global problems, career contribution, personal fit, and strategy.
keywords: how to choose a career to help the world
takeaways: Career choice can vary greatly in impact, so picking the right path may matter far more than usual.
Making a difference is framed as improving lives, regardless of who or when, with a focus on the future.
Important problems are judged by importance, neglectedness and tractability; reducing catastrophic risks is flagged as a likely top priority.
Early career focus should be on building skills with high leverage, and personal fit and comparative advantage should guide choices.
Strategy includes being ambitious, exploring before settling, balancing impact with happiness, and avoiding unintended harm.
summary.summary: This page is an index for a series of 80,000 Hours articles that deepen their career guide on increasing the impact of your career. It is organised into sections covering what making a difference means, the world's most pressing problems, which career paths offer high contribution and leverage, personal fit, and overall career strategy. Each section lists short descriptions of linked articles rather than full content. The page also points readers to a free one-on-one call with the 80,000 Hours team and to hundreds of further articles filterable by cause and career path.
